```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

### Setup and Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales) # Needed for the log scale formatting
```

### 1. Raw Data & Parse

```{r raw_and_parse}
lines <- readLines("C:/Users/Dirk/Downloads/supermarket/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price)
  )
```

### 2. Mapping & Cleaning

```{r mapping_and_cleaning}
dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)])

long_data_clean <- long_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = ifelse(time > 0, price / time, NA_real_)
  )
```

### 3. Summary

```{r summary}
basket_data <- long_data_clean %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = total_time / total_items,
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price),
    min_price = min(price),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### 4. EDA - Anomaly Exploration

#### TRISTAN: Price-Based Anomalies

```{r tristan_price_anomalies}
# 1. Very low / very high total price (> $500 or < $0.50)
ggplot(basket_data, aes(y = total_price)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", outlier.color = "red", outlier.shape = 16) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 500, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Total Basket Price w/ Cutoffs (> $500 or < $0.50)", 
       y = "Total Price (Log Scale)")

extreme_price_baskets <- basket_data %>%
  filter(total_price > 500 | total_price < 0.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_price))

print("Extreme Price Baskets:")
head(extreme_price_baskets)


# 2. Expensive items in small baskets (<= 3 items, max item price > $100)
ggplot(basket_data, aes(x = total_items, y = max_price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkblue") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Max Item Price vs. Basket Size", 
       subtitle = "Top-Left Box indicates Small Baskets (<= 3 items) with Expensive Items (> $100)",
       x = "Total Items in Basket", 
       y = "Max Price of a Single Item (Log Scale)")

expensive_small_baskets <- basket_data %>%
  filter(total_items <= 3 & max_price > 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_price))

print("Expensive Small Baskets:")
head(expensive_small_baskets)
```

#### HANNES: Time-Based Anomalies

```{r hannes_time_anomalies}
# 1. Extremely fast / extremely slow scanning (< 0.5s or > 120s)
ggplot(basket_data, aes(x = avg_time_per_item)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "lightgreen", color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 120, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Scan Time per Item w/ Cutoffs (< 0.5s or > 120s)", 
       x = "Average Time per Item (seconds, Log Scale)", 
       y = "Frequency")

extreme_time_baskets <- basket_data %>%
  filter(avg_time_per_item < 0.5 | avg_time_per_item > 120) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_time_per_item))

print("Extreme Time Baskets:")
head(extreme_time_baskets)


# 2. Checking total_time vs total_items
ggplot(basket_data, aes(x = total_items, y = total_time)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "purple") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Total Time vs Total Items (Log Scale)",
       x = "Total Items",
       y = "Total Time (seconds, Log Scale)")
```
